description: This file contains unit tests for the RialtoServerMediaPipelineCallback class, verifying its notification forwarding behavior for playback state, position, network state, media data requests, QoS, and cache clearing. It uses Google Test framework and mocks to simulate interactions.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaPipelineCallbackTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from MediaPipelineTestBase, setting up media pipeline and Gst player mock, and providing helper methods for testing callback notifications.

methods.name: setPlaybackStatePlaying
methods.description: Sets the playback state to PLAYING and expects the media pipeline client to be notified.
